title: New Baseball Game  - 9th Inning Game
author: Adventurous-Light660
selftext:
First time game maker, non-frequent AI user, but a big daily sports game player (like immaculate grid). Tried to develop my own daily baseball game website with some trivia and mini games mixed in. TBH I like the mini games more than the main daily game, so might start to pivot towards that more. Main goal was to create a few simple, quick and easy (and even dumb) to play daily games. Open to any and all feedback on what to improve on! Trying to get it out into the sports community, maybe make something similar for hockey since thats my 2nd favorite sport. 

  
I started developing in Claude. After about 15 different versions I decided to make it a public website. GitHub stores it and Cloudflare hosts it...plus a cloudflare worker for the counter. It is pretty fun and easy to update at this point as suggestions roll in from friends and fam! Still learning as I go
